video_evidence_status: not independently verified; recommendations may be format-level guidance

entries.principle: Keep essential action and text inside mobile platform safe zones
entries.execution_guidance: Frame faces and supers away from interface overlays

entries.principle: Compose tighter vertical headroom around facial expression
entries.execution_guidance: Prioritise expressive faces within portrait-oriented compositions

entries.principle: Storyboard and shoot for multiple aspect ratios
entries.execution_guidance: Plan 9:16 guides during filming instead of relying on a late horizontal crop

entries.principle: Front-load the user benefit or problem in the first two seconds
entries.execution_guidance: For short BAU utility films, omit greetings and get to the offer or value immediately

entries.principle: Make critical information understandable on mute
entries.execution_guidance: Use legible timed captions for features and calls to action

entries.principle: Mix spoken dialogue for intelligibility on mobile speakers
entries.execution_guidance: Keep voice crisp and prominent relative to music at low playback volume
